title: Yahya bin Khalid and the Poor Man
logline: A poor man asks the vizier Yahya for help and is given a room, fine food and a thousand dirhams every day with no end date; after thirty days he panics that it is too much, and sneaks away with his sack from a door that was never going to close.
moral: True generosity keeps no account. Fear of losing a gift can cost more than the gift: the man kept thirty thousand and walked away from a lifetime of welcome.
tone: Warm, gently comic and a little wistful. The comedy is the gap between what the poor man imagines (a stern accountant) and what Yahya is (a host who never counts). No villain, no punishment.

beats.summary: Yahya rides home through Baghdad from the caliph's palace.
He sees a poor man waiting at his door; the man stands, greets him and asks for help.
Yahya asks nothing about who he is: no family, no trade. He orders a room.
The order to the treasurer: one thousand dirhams every day and the family's own food.
No end date is set. The treasurer's empty box is the plant for the ending.
Days and weeks spin by: eating, resting, a purse every morning.
Thirty nights, thirty thousand dirhams, one big sack.
Joy turns to fear: he imagines Yahya checking the accounts and asking for some back.
He packs in silence and tiptoes out at night without a goodbye.
The servants report it and brace; Yahya is not angry and sends no one.
Yahya: had he stayed to the end of his life, neither food nor money would have stopped.
The man is gone with his sack; the door of hospitality stays open.

props.description: Planned purse: fat drawstring coin purse about 60 x 70 with fill 0..1 (0 = flat and limp, insideOut option for S3) and an optional mark "1000".
Planned coinPile with the silver palette (dirhams): single coin, short stacks, a floor heap that grows (n), and a tall column in the S11 cloud.
Planned sack with fill 0..1 and a coin mark; here at s 1.6 (about 190 wide x 300 tall), tied mouth with a knot, a bulge field, and a carried state on the back.
Planned brass tray 150 x 16 with bread, a rice dome, dates and a cup; optional domed cover that lifts; steam.
The treasurer's account book: closed 70 x 90 red-brown with a yellow spine; open 150 x 100 showing ruled lines, tally strokes (n 0..30) and an UNTIL line with an empty box.
The guest's few belongings tied in a cloth: packLoad(ctx, ['bindle'], x, y, s) on the floor, then hanging from his free hand.
Planned moonCounter extended to rows: 30 moon icons (r 20) in 3 rows of 10, pitch 62 x 58, in panel space, lighting in order.

scenes.summary: Night street. He squeezes out of the house door, tiptoes past a dozing servant without a goodbye, and hurries off believing he has saved his treasure. Behind him the door drifts open, lit and unguarded.

scenes.summary: Morning. The servants find the room empty, run to Yahya and report: gone in secret, with thirty thousand dirhams. They brace for his anger.

camera.notes: 127.24-131.4 in the guest room doorway (drawn as an inset panel, see notes); whip to the hall at 131.4; medium three-shot.

actions.action: comes in cheerfully with the breakfast tray and today's purse, and stops
actions.acting: smile fades, gaze sweeps couch to floor where the sack stood

actions.action: walks into his back
actions.acting: bump: A lurches, the tray wobbles, a date hops

actions.acting: staggered run, A first; Yahya is reading a scroll

actions.action: lowers the scroll and looks up
actions.acting: calm, brows a little raised, gaze from one to the other

actions.action: mimes it: two fingers walking away

scenes.summary: The explosion never comes. Yahya is not angry and sends no one after him; he only wonders that the man thought kindness could suddenly stop.

scenes.summary: Ending. Dawn on the street: far away the man goes off with his sack, small and alone; the camera returns to the house, whose door stands wide open with Yahya in it. THE END.

camera.notes: Wide at dawn. 161-166.5 framed on the left end of the street (cam x 400); 167.0-168.5 slow pan right to the house (cam x 620, zoom 1.25); hold.

scenes.composition: Far figure: s 0.35 at x 120..-40, y 880 on the far end of the street. House door right of centre, fully open, light spilling in a yellow wedge down the steps. THE END in the sky left of the house, above y 330.

actions.action: arrow and label STILL OPEN on the door

actions.action: one slow blink and a nod toward the road
actions.acting: the last acting beat; then stillness except the light

actions.action: THE END
actions.acting: style title, held to 175.77; Yahya and the open door stay in frame

ending.description: Dawn street, wide. The far road is empty where the man went; the house door stands fully open with warm light on the steps, Yahya in the doorway and a fresh tray on the top step. THE END (Bangers, in the sky left of the house) from 172.3 to 175.77, with one quiet chime at 172.6. The light wedge keeps breathing so the hold is not a freeze.

subtitles.ar: عاد يحيى بن خالد البرمكي ذات يوم|من قصر الخليفة إلى بيته في بغداد.|وعند باب الدار رأى رجلًا فقيرًا ينتظره.|وقف الرجل احترامًا له، وسلم عليه، ثم قال إنه جاء يطلب مساعدته.
subtitles.en: Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki returned home|from the caliph’s palace|and found a poor man waiting at his gate,|hoping for help.

subtitles.ar: أخبر الرجل يحيى أنه في حاجة شديدة إلى المال،|وطلب منه أن يكون كريمًا معه.|لم يسأله يحيى عن نسبه أو عمله،|بل أمر أن يجهزوا له غرفة مريحة داخل البيت.
subtitles.en: The man explained|his desperate need.|Yahya asked neither about his family nor his occupation,|but ordered a comfortable room prepared for him inside.

subtitles.ar: ثم استدعى يحيى خازنه،|وأمره أن يعطي الضيف ألف درهم كل يوم،|وأن يقدم له من الطعام الجيد مثل ما يأكل أهل البيت.|لم يحدد له يومًا تنتهي فيه الضيافة.
subtitles.en: Yahya instructed his treasurer|to give the guest one thousand dirhams daily|and serve him the same fine food enjoyed by the household,|without setting a deadline.

subtitles.ar: بقي الرجل في الدار أيامًا، ثم أسابيع،|وهو يأكل ويستريح ويتلقى المال بانتظام.|وكل صباح كانت تصل إليه ألف درهم جديدة،|حتى جمع مبلغًا لم يحلم يومًا أن يكون في يده.
subtitles.en: The man stayed for days and then weeks,|eating well and receiving the regular payment.|Each morning brought|another thousand dirhams.

subtitles.ar: مرت ثلاثون ليلة، فصار معه ثلاثون ألف درهم.|أخذ يتأمل الكيس الكبير،|وخاف أن يراجع يحيى حسابه، فيرى أن المبلغ تجاوز ما ينبغي،|ثم يطلب منه إعادة جزء منه.
subtitles.en: After thirty days he held thirty thousand dirhams.|He began to fear|that Yahya would notice how much he had received|and demand some back.

subtitles.ar: لم يشأ الرجل أن ينتظر حتى يتبين الأمر،|فجمع أمتعته في هدوء، وحمل المال كله،|وخرج من البيت سرًا دون وداع.|وظن أنه بهذه الطريقة سيحتفظ بما حصل عليه من العطاء.
subtitles.en: Rather than risk the imagined demand,|he packed quietly|and slipped away with all the money,|saying no farewell.

subtitles.ar: عندما علم الخدم برحيله،|أخبروا يحيى أنه غادر خفية بعدما جمع ثلاثين ألف درهم.|لم يغضب يحيى، ولم يرسل أحدًا ليعيده،|بل تعجب من أن الرجل ظن الكرم يمكن أن ينتهي فجأة.
subtitles.en: When servants reported|his secret departure,|Yahya neither grew angry nor sent anyone after him.|He was surprised that the man had feared his generosity would end.

subtitles.ar: قال يحيى إنه لو بقي الضيف في بيته حتى آخر عمره،|لما قطع عنه الطعام ولا المال.|وهكذا انتهت القصة برحيل الرجل مع ما جمعه،|وبقاء باب الضيافة مفتوحًا في نية صاحبه.
subtitles.en: Yahya declared that even if the guest had stayed for life,|he would never have stopped the gifts or meals.|The man was gone,|though the welcome had never ended.

new_assets.name: guestRoom (palaceHall merchant dressing)
new_assets.description: A comfortable guest room made from the merchant variant of palaceHall plus a diwan, low table, rug and lamp; the window is a live time-of-day clock. Reusable for any guest, inn or bedroom scene.
new_assets.implementation: function guestRoom(ctx, o): call palaceHall({variant:'merchant', wall:'ochre', desk:false, shelves:[one jar shelf], u:o.u, doorOpen:o.door, t}) then draw the dressing with kit shapes; return anchors {door, table:{x:330, top:822}, diwan:{x0:580, x1:880, sitY:836, lieX:730}, heap:{x:460}, window}. Night: townDim or a navy multiply rect with a radial lamp circle (as hutRoom dark).

new_assets.name: diwan
new_assets.description: Planned low couch (AN-092): 300 wide, seat top 64 above the floor, rolled arm at the right end (r 34), one long striped mattress (red and yellow stripes), a round pillow at the arm, two loose cushions with squash fields.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded rects and circles with ink outlines; dotPat for Ben-Day shading; cushions take sq so they dent when poked or sat on. The seated person uses seat:"bench" at sitY; the lying person uses lie:1 at the seat top.

new_assets.name: purse
new_assets.description: Planned fat coin purse with fill 0..1, insideOut state and an optional number mark.
new_assets.implementation: Teardrop path scaled by fill, drawstring neck (two short lines and a knot), yellow coin glint at the mouth when fill > 0.5; insideOut draws the pale lining shape hanging down.

new_assets.name: coinPile
new_assets.description: Planned coin mound with the silver palette for dirhams and single coin, stack, heap and column modes.
new_assets.implementation: Seeded ellipses (K.rng) stacked in rows for a heap; stacks as short columns of ellipses; palette {face: C.white, edge: grey, dot: C.blue}.

new_assets.name: sack
new_assets.description: Planned sack with fill, coin mark, bulge and a carried state.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded bag path whose width follows fill and bulge; tied neck with two ears; a coin disc mark; drawn behind the bent person for the carried state (person tip 0.3).

new_assets.name: foodTray
new_assets.description: Planned brass tray with food and an optional lifting dome cover.
new_assets.implementation: Flat yellow ellipse rim, small shapes for bread, rice dome, dates and cup; cover is a half ellipse with a knob translated up by open; steam() above.

new_assets.name: ledger
new_assets.description: Account book with closed and open states, tally strokes and an empty UNTIL box.
new_assets.implementation: Two page quads with a spine; ruled lines with seg(); n tally strokes drawn in order; the box is a stroked rect whose content is a tag drawn by the style (NO END DATE). A quill is a white feather shape on the hand.

new_assets.name: moonCounter (rows)
new_assets.description: Planned moonCounter extended with a rows option so thirty nights fit in the panel.
new_assets.implementation: Loop n icons at pitch 62 x 58, each a disc that goes from dark outline to lit yellow with a crescent shadow when lit > i; draw in panel space after the camera.

new_assets.name: sneak
new_assets.description: Planned tiptoe option for walk(): high knees, short stride, a hold on each toe, shoulders raised.
new_assets.implementation: walk(xf, t, {stride: 46}) with the phase eased into steps (hold 40 % of each step) and the person lifted 6 units on each hold; x keys step in the same rhythm so feet do not slide.

new_assets.name: handOver
new_assets.description: Planned hand-to-hand pass of a small object (the purse) with a weight dip and both gazes following.
new_assets.implementation: Object position = blend(handA world, handB world) over 0.25 s from P.hands of each person; receiver hand dips 8 units on arrival.

new_assets.name: person carrying a load on the back
new_assets.description: Planned pose (AN-132): bent under a sack, tip 0.3, knees bent, one hand over the shoulder on the sack neck.
new_assets.implementation: Draw the sack first at the shoulder point rotated with the body, then person {tip:0.3, sq:0.95, handR near the shoulder}; walk amplitude reduced to 0.7.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English translation is a condensed version of the Arabic (P1 omits that the man stood up and greeted Yahya, P4 omits "until he had gathered a sum he had never dreamed of holding", P6 omits "he thought that this way he would keep what he had been given", P8 summarises the closing line); both are kept verbatim and the English chunks are matched to the nearest Arabic phrase.
Yahya arrives on a white horse with a servant behind him (the script only says he returned from the palace); default: keep the horse.

Invented English lettering beyond sound words: YAHYA THE VIZIER, CALIPH'S PALACE, HOME, BAGHDAD, A POOR MAN, SALAM!, FAMILY?, JOB?, GUEST ROOM, THE TREASURER, EVERY DAY, GOOD FOOD, FAMILY, GUEST, NO END DATE, 30 NIGHTS, 30,000 DIRHAMS, THE BIG SACK, TOO MUCH!, GIVE IT BACK!, GONE!, IF HE HAD STAYED..., STILL OPEN; default: keep all (they are labels on key beats).

In S11 the man's fear is shown as a thought cloud with a stern, angry Yahya holding out his hand (GIVE IT BACK!); it is clearly imagined, but it does show Yahya unkind for a few seconds; default: keep.
In S7 Yahya's household is shown as a lady and a child eating (a diagram of "what the household eats"); default: keep.
In S13 a servant dozes by the door as the man tiptoes past, and the door drifts open behind him; default: keep (added for suspense and irony).
In S16 the vision shows the guest growing old on the couch with a white beard and an equally aged servant still bringing the tray; default: keep (gentle humour for "to the end of his life").
The LATER... card plays over the spoken words "thirty nights passed" (83.4-84.9) instead of in a silence, because the narration has no pause there; default: keep the card.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. World 1000 x 1230, floor or ground y 900. Set LIFE.t = t each frame so every person blinks; add explicit blinks where lid is set by hand.

People: yahya {costume:"vizier", age:0.55, s:1.3}; poorMan {costume:"villager", age:0.3, s:1.2, pal:{robe:"#b9a77a", dot:"#8a6a3a", shoes:"bare", sash:C.red}} plus two patch rects drawn on the skirt by the scene; treasurer {costume:"merchant", pal:{robe:GREEN, dot:GREEND, hc:C.yellow, hd:C.red}}; servants {costume:"servant"} with pal for the blue one. All dialogue uses lookAt / look() so speaker and listener keep eye contact.

S1: rideOn(ctx, "horse", {...walk(HX, t, {stride: GAIT.horse*0.8}), y:900, s:0.8, pal:0}, {costume:"vizier", age:0.55, lurch: lurch(t, 7.4)}); HX = kfn [[0.42,-220],[7.4,300]] eased out. The dismount is hidden by the close shot 11.2-13.0; from 15.5 Yahya is a standing person walking from x 250 to x 420, and the horse is gone (led off left by servantA at 12.5-14).

gateStreet: const A = marketStreet(ctx, {palette, palace:"lit", palaceDoor, u, t}); use A.palace.door {x0, x1, top, bottom:872, cx:750} for everyone who stands on the step and A.ground (900) on the street. Draw people who come out of the door clipped to the door opening until they pass the frame.

guestRoom window clock: one function U(t) (kfn) gives the time of day for every guest room scene: S5 0.25; S8 runs 0.25 + (t-64.3)*2 mod 1; S9 0.9 to 1.0 and one-shot flashes per morning; S10-S12 0.75; S14 0.05. Dim the room with the dayCycle night value.

Counters: one running total drawn with the style counter in panel space (top right), values keyed: 1000 at 75.98, to 12,000 by 78.8, 29,000 to 30,000 at 88.8-89.6. The DAY / WEEK counter is separate, top left.

Thought clouds: thoughtCloud(ctx, x, y, w, h, t, {p, tail, bg, scale, at, inside}); S11 cloud blue (cold fear) 620 x 400 at (500, 330); S15 cloud yellow 520 x 340 at (400, 330); S16 vision 880 x 620 at (480, 400), p keyed 152.76 to 153.26 and back at 160.6 to 161.0. Keep figures inside at least 110 px tall on screen.
S14 opens in the guestRoom although the scene set is the hall: draw the guest room for 127.24-131.4 and whip to the hall at 131.4 (a camera key pair 0.01 s apart under a 3-frame whip smear).
Camera: build keys per scene from the camera notes; use twoShot(a, b, {margin}) for S2, S3, S6, S7; clamp as in the template. Shake only inside the panel clip, and only at 7.4 (2 units).
Sound: SND master 0.6, 5 effects only (7.72 thud, 15.86 chime, 22.4 pop, 41.95 pop, 172.6 chime). The narration has only three real pauses, so coins, purses and doors are silent picture events.

Subtitles: 4 chunks per paragraph as marked in "subtitles"; time each chunk from the first Arabic word of the chunk in timing.json. English is shorter than the Arabic, so several English chunks are short.
Lettering never covers a face; labels live in the sky or wall above y 470 world. No en or em dashes anywhere. Headline sizes as in CLAUDE.md.
Call the style finish last every frame; every motion is a function of t (kfn, blend, pulse, K.rng with fixed seeds).
warnings: The narration is nearly continuous (three pauses of 0.6 s or more, all in the first 23 s), so only 5 sound effects are planned; do not add coin or door sounds over words.
English is a condensed translation: chunk 4 of P4 and P6 show English that does not translate the Arabic being spoken at that moment.
The person figure is front facing only: "bows", "turns to the door" and "looks back" must be acted with tip, gaze, dir flips (turnFlip) and hands, not a profile.
Arms are short (about 74 units): hugging the 190 wide sack is drawn with the hands on its near edge and the sack overlapping the body.
S8-S9 repeat one action many times; vary the treasurer and the guest slightly on each repeat so it does not read as a loop.
guestRoom uses the merchant variant of palaceHall: check on a still that with desk:false and one shelf it does not read as a shop; if it does, add the rug, diwan and a second cushion first.
